method: Graphical lasso (EBIC) with stability selection, pairwise LiNGAM orientation, structural VAR(1), Diebold-Yilmaz connectedness
findings: 100 monthly series and 28 judged concepts; 250 same-month links are selected in at least 70% of 60 half-samples. 92 are established (selected in 90% at a stricter penalty), with at most 7.7 expected false among them (Meinshausen-Buhlmann bound). Regressing each series on its parents keeps 174 with |t| >= 2 (76 removed), 78 of them established.
75% of them point the way their own pairwise evidence says; 63 links from one series to another next month pass |t| >= 2.5, and 57 series carry their own momentum.
System connectedness is 28%: the share of a typical series' 12-month forecast error that comes from other series' shocks.
Rolling 5-year connectedness peaked at 90% in 2020-04 and reads 87% now.
